data.long_description:
An exceptional opportunity to own a spacious 4 bedroom Quortaj Villa in the heart of Al Furjan. This beautifully positioned facing garden unit offers privacy, generous outdoor space, pool , and a prime internal location within walking distance to key community landmarks.

Property Details:
• 4 Bedrooms
• 6 Bathrooms
• Main and Show kitchen
• Maid’s room
• Laundry room
• private gym
• Private swimming pool
• Garden facing unit
• Internal quiet location

Size:
• Plot Size: 6,459 sq ft

Location Highlights:
• Walking distance to Al Furjan Metro Station
• Walking distance to Al Furjan Community Centre
• Walking distance to Arcadia School
• Close to kids park

'Quortaj' properties are the original icons of Al Furjan. Situated within a family community comprising of walkable gardens & children's parks. The central location of the property is located next to the local Pavilion offering supermarkets, food outlets, Swimming Pool, leisure club and Al Furjan's very own Metro Station. Al Furjan has achieved an average of 38% property value increase across the past 12 months with more appreciation still to come.
